grinsegold_female_pirate_boots.description: Adaptation from a blendswap mesh quick and durty more like a test. The knees shouldn't be covered that much i guess but as i said - quick and dirty. This is far from being low poly but he made nice textures. The last texture the displacement texture is a bump map for scratches.

toigo_ankle_boots_female.author: MargaretToigo
toigo_ankle_boots_female.description: This is a pair of ankle boots that will fit most female humans. I have included diffuse specular and normal maps and the .mhmat file should get them all imported into Blender where their properties can be adjusted according to preference and render engine. Illustration shows shoes with subsurf of two and a mean crease of one around the heel and sole edge loops.

toigo_ankle_boots_male.author: MargaretToigo
toigo_ankle_boots_male.description: This is a pair of ankle boots that will fit most male humans. I have included diffuse specular and normal maps and the .mhmat file should get them all imported into Blender where their properties can be adjusted according to preference and render engine. These boots have the same UV mapping as my Ankle Boots http://www.makehumancommunity.org/clothes/ankle_boots.html . Illustration shows boots with subsurf of two and a mean crease of one around the heel and sole edge loops.

toigo_ballet_flats.author: MargaretToigo
toigo_ballet_flats.description: This is a pair of women's ballet-style flats. They will fit most female humans around ages 15-50 without much adjustment. I have included diffuse specular and normal maps and the .mhmat file should get them all imported into Blender where their properties can be adjusted according to preference and render engine. Illustration shows shoes with subsurf of two and a mean crease of one around the heel edge loops.

toigo_mj_cloth_shoes.author: MargaretToigo
toigo_mj_cloth_shoes.description: This is a pair of very low poly shoes 556 vertices 278 per shoe that will fit a wide range of humans but fit best on mostly female humans above age four. Of course the shoes will need a subdivision surface of at least two three or four is even better and creasing on key edge loops -- as shown in the illustration. I have created a forum thread with a more detailed explanation of the edge loops... http://www.makehumancommunity.org/forum/viewtopic.php?f=4&t=16689 I have included diffuse specular and normal maps and the .mhmat file should get them all imported into Blender where their properties can be adjusted according to preference and render engine. Two additional colors are available in Materials.

toigo_stiletto_booties.author: MargaretToigo
toigo_stiletto_booties.description: This is a pair of booties with stiletto heels. They will fit average female -- age weight muscle height and proportions -- humans. I have included diffuse specular and normal maps and the .mhmat file should get them all imported into Blender where their properties can be adjusted according to preference and render engine. Four additional colors are available in Materials.
